mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (name, category_id, image, description, flavors, price, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{image}, #{description}, #{flavors}, #{price}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, image = #{image}, description = #{description}, flavors = #{flavors}, price = #{price}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dish WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
